siteDefaults.title: Site Policy Defaults
siteDefaults.hint: Applied to every new site you create - these are policy decisions that are almost always the same across an organization, not a real per-site attribute. Any existing site keeps its own saved value; you can still override any of these for a specific site from that site's own Edit form.

breakRoundingMode.full_hour: Rounds up to a full hour

siteDefaults.invalidGpsTolerance: Enter a GPS accuracy tolerance greater than zero.
siteDefaults.genericError: Unable to update the site defaults.

sitePolicy.title: Site rules
sitePolicy.hint: This site's GPS margin, shift hours, overtime and late deductions, break rounding, presence monitoring, exempt people and self clock-in limits.
sitePolicy.noSites: No sites yet - add one from Sites first.
sitePolicy.loadError: Unable to load this site's policy.
sitePolicy.noAssignmentsYet: No one is assigned to this site yet, so there's no one to exempt.
sitePolicy.genericError: Unable to update this site's policy.

area.title: Where the site is and its range
area.hint: The site's range and how people clock in there. Its name, address and coordinates change on the site's page.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.hint: Read-only keys let another system - an ERP, accounting, HR or reporting tool - read your data through the PROSM Time API. Give each key only the scopes it needs. A key can never change anything in PROSM Time.
integrations.createError: Unable to create this API key.
integrations.revokeError: Unable to revoke this API key.
integrations.newKeyWarning: Copy this now - it will not be shown again. Only its prefix is kept afterward.
integrations.revokeWarning: "{{name}}" stops working immediately and cannot be restored. The system using it will need a new key.

webhooks.title: Instant notifications to other systems (webhooks)
webhooks.hint: The other system is told the moment something happens. Each message is signed with a secret shown once; if the system is down, PROSM Time tries again with growing waits for a day. No amounts or contact details are sent.

off.too_many_failures: Turned off after 20 failed deliveries in a row

webhooks.secretWarning: Copy it now into the other system - it will not be shown again. It checks that each message came from PROSM Time.

integrations.rotateWarning: A new key replaces "{{name}}" with the same scopes. The old key keeps working for 24 hours, so you can update the other system, then it stops by itself.

payroll.title: Payroll Integration
payroll.notConfigured: This integration isn't set up yet - ask your administrator to add its API credentials.

rejectMockLocation.label: Reject clock in/out from a fake location
rejectMockLocation.hint: Android reports when a location comes from a mock-location (fake GPS) app. Off: it is recorded and sent to managers for review. On: the clock in or out is refused.

sessionPolicy.title: Shifts left open
sessionPolicy.hint: Nothing closes at the end of a shift. After the first number of hours the employee is asked "still working?" and the managers are told once; after the second the shift is closed automatically and its hours wait for a manager's review.
sessionPolicy.invalid: The alert must come before the close (1 to 72 hours).

overtimePolicy.title: Overtime and deductions
overtimePolicy.hint: For the whole organisation. Blank = the default. Multipliers apply on top of the overtime-hour price; 1 keeps today's amounts.

field.roundMinutes: Round each day's worked time to (minutes)

overtimePolicy.alertLabel: Overtime alert (minutes after the shift ends)
overtimePolicy.alertHint: You are told when someone is still clocked in this many minutes after their shift ends. 15 by default; a negative number warns before the end.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.hint: Changes apply to coming entitlements; balances already set are kept.
leaveTypes.name: Name
leaveTypes.enforceBalance: Refuse a request beyond the balance
leaveTypes.maxTimesInService: Maximum times in the whole service
leaveTypes.invalidTiers: Write the tiers as years:days separated by commas.

plan.redeemFailed: The code is wrong or already used.
plan.always: In every plan: clocking at the site with geofence and photo proof, offline, the live map, SOS, radio, weather and 9 languages.

features.on_behalf: Clocking on behalf of an employee
features.export: Full dashboard, reports centre and export
features.scheduling: Shift scheduling, open shifts and swaps
features.roles_manager: All managers and supervisors (Starter: one manager)
features.labor_cost: External labour pay and labour cost
features.manager_alerts: Manager alerts (missed shift, overtime, morning summary)
features.integrations: Integrations, API and attendance from fingerprint devices

plan.managedByProsm: Any change or renewal of your licence is made by PROSM; you get a notification and an email with the new licence. To change it, write to sales@prosm.net.
plan.historyAll: Attendance records shown: all of them. Location points and photos are deleted automatically after the period in “Data retention”.
plan.history_one: Attendance records shown and reported: the last year. Older records are kept and come back with a higher plan. Location points and photos are deleted automatically after the period in “Data retention”.
plan.history_other: Attendance records shown and reported: the last {{count}} years. Older records are kept and come back with a higher plan. Location points and photos are deleted automatically after the period in “Data retention”.
plan.billedHint: Employees + one user per 10 external workers

retention.title: Data retention
retention.subtitle: You can only shorten these. A shorter period also applies to stored data, and anything older is deleted automatically.

clockSuggestion.title: Ask when the app opens inside a site
clockSuggestion.subtitle: When someone opens the app inside a site, it asks whether to clock in. Nothing is recorded without their answer, the ordinary clock-in follows, and no background location is used.
clockSuggestion.label: Ask the person to clock in

overtimeTarget.title: Counting overtime and lateness
overtimeTarget.hint: Choose where the overtime and lateness from attendance are counted. Approved days and cycles do not change.
overtimeTarget.error: The choice could not be saved. Try again.

payroll.label: On the salary
payroll.hint: Suggested in the payroll cycle for you to accept.

allowances.label: On the allowances
allowances.hint: Overtime is priced on the allowance sheets.

counted.label: Counted
counted.hint: Overtime is priced on the allowance sheets.

none.label: Not counted
none.hint: Affects nothing - it only shows in the hours.

jobTitles.title: Job titles
jobTitles.hint: The company's job titles: chosen in each employee's file, and used by documents required for a job.
jobTitles.name: Job title

ownership.title: Transfer the ownership
ownership.subtitle: The only way the owner changes.
ownership.explain: Choose an active member. They must accept, then 72 hours pass while every manager is told; you can cancel until it completes. After it, you become a manager.
ownership.started: The transfer started. Waiting for the recipient to accept.
ownership.waitingForYou: {{name}} wants to transfer the organisation's ownership to you. Accept to continue.
ownership.cooling: {{name}} accepted. The transfer completes after {{when}} unless it is cancelled.
ownership.ready: The waiting period is over. The transfer to {{name}} can be completed now.
ownership.accepted: Accepted. The transfer can be completed after 72 hours.
ownership.failed: This step could not be done.

connectUsage.title: Connect usage (calls and meetings)
connectUsage.subtitle: This month: what went directly between devices (free) and what went through a relay (counted against the relay's free allowance).
connectUsage.empty: No measured calls this month yet.
connectUsage.total: Through a relay {{relay}} MB of {{total}} MB.

security.title: Security for sensitive actions
security.subtitle: Approving or reopening payroll, publishing payslips, API keys, changing permissions, transferring ownership.

stepUp.title: Confirm identity before a sensitive action
stepUp.hint: If the last sign-in is older than 10 minutes, the app asks for the password (or the two-step code) before going ahead.

mfa.title: Require two-step verification for the owner, payroll approvers and permission assigners
mfa.hint: The confirmation is a code from an authenticator app (Google or Microsoft Authenticator), not the password alone. Anyone without it is asked to set it up first.

security.platformOn: Turned on by the platform for every organisation.
security.howTo: Each person turns on two-step verification from their profile > Security: scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.

employeeCodes.title: Employee codes
employeeCodes.subtitle: 5 sequential digits by hiring seniority.
employeeCodes.hint: A code is given automatically as soon as a hiring date is entered, and it stays. If you add older hiring dates, number everyone again here to restore seniority order. Approved payroll keeps its codes.
employeeCodes.confirm: Number every employee again by hiring date? Current codes will change.

governance.title: Governance model
governance.subtitle: Who decides employees' requests. Choose the model that fits your company - read how each one works before choosing.
governance.appliesTo: Applies to: leave, permissions and attendance corrections

direct.title: Simple (default)
direct.tagline: Any manager responsible for the employee decides, in one step.
direct.how: The request shows to everyone with authority over the employee: their site manager, department manager, HR and the owner. The first to decide closes it.

perms.1: Site manager: decides for their site's people
perms.2: Department manager: decides for their department

flow.2: It shows to everyone responsible for them
flow.3: The first one approves or rejects
flow.4: The employee is notified of the decision

decentralized.title: Decentralized
decentralized.tagline: Operations decide: the site or the department.
decentralized.how: The site or department manager decides for their people. HR steps in only when the employee has no direct manager; the owner is always the fallback.

perms.1: Site or department manager: decides for their people
perms.2: HR: only for those without a direct manager

flow.2: It goes to their site or department manager
flow.4: The employee is notified of the decision

decentralized.fits: Fits: companies with many branches and sites, each manager responsible for their people.

centralized.title: Centralized
centralized.how: Every request goes to HR. Site and department managers follow their people but do not decide; the owner and deputies are the fallback.

perms.2: Site and department managers: follow only

flow.4: The employee is notified of the decision

centralized.fits: Fits: companies with a strong HR department that want one consistent decision.

two_step.title: Combined (two steps)
two_step.tagline: The manager approves first, then HR confirms.
two_step.how: The site or department manager approves, then the request moves to HR for the final approval. A rejection by either closes it. With no direct manager it goes straight to HR; one person holding both roles approves once.

perms.1: Site or department manager: first approval

flow.3: Once approved it goes to HR
flow.5: The employee is notified of the decision

two_step.fits: Fits: medium and large companies (100+ employees).

always.1: Payroll, allowances, penalties, permissions, billing and ownership stay with the owner
always.3: The owner and deputies can decide any request
always.4: A closed payroll period cannot be changed
always.5: Every decision and every model change is recorded in the audit log

governance.perKind: Fine tuning: a different model per request kind
governance.needHr: Nobody holds "Decide every employee's non-sensitive requests (HR)". Give it to someone on the permissions page, or requests go to the owner.
governance.needManagers: There are no site or department managers. Set them first, or requests go to HR or the owner.
governance.confirmNote: It applies at once to new and still-pending requests: leave, permissions and attendance corrections.
